messages.text: Your refund of **BRL 69.90** has been paid and recorded against the order’s original payment. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
Does the money go back to my card or to store credit?

It’s recorded against the order’s original payment, not as store credit. The receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger; it isn’t a bank transfer, and the shop can’t say when it will appear on your card. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
